title: Research: paid infinite-order returns save 260 echo operations
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A fixed infinite-order shear drift can be carried between equivariant children
and returned with an explicitly paid binary doubling/halving sequence. The
53-child dirty echo costs **2,234 instructions versus 2,494**: 380 ADDs removed,
120 SCALEs added. Every dirty coordinate is restored. The forward prefix
row-L1 bound rises from **87 to 4,195**, requiring six more magnitude bits by
that bound. At a common adequate width, the invoice improves only when
SCALE/ADD price is below 19/6.

Status: **recursive-interface research construction and scoped obstruction**.
The package proves that direct unit-power transport alone has exact boundary
cost km, then supplies the changed paid return mechanism, literal words,
complete depth/storage recurrence and a nested 4,960-to-4,860 composition.
No minimum circuit, runtime gain, physical supplier or new kappa is claimed.
No selected child with an indivisible version of this drift is instantiated.

All additions are under `research/unipotent-return-seed53/`. Review the
fixed-child premise, the binary return cost, and the precision tradeoff in
README.md; exact evidence is in RESULT.json.

## Task and overlap

Base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`. OS seed **53**, recursive
interfaces. The `persistent-boundary` card is **refined** to an infinite-order
drift with explicitly lowered terminal powers. This changes the cost mechanism
and is not another finite-order cyclic census. The bounded domain and local
claim are in CLAIM.md and TASK.json.

PR1287 is pinned at `8606df05eca3c65032361c74ee3dbc2630b0cdc4`, with its
unchanged README and byte/Git-blob pins retained. No predecessor executable is
imported. PR1227 supplies earlier sign-frame work; PR1391/1410/1499 and PR1488
cover finite-order cyclic/S3 transport. PR1439/1506 cover source/operator repair.
Native BIT PR521/677/840 use another contract. None of their gains is combined
with this invoice. The selected PR1094 result and upstream/ remain unchanged.

Submission refresh covered 773 open PRs and 199 discussion records with complete
pagination, then checked the latest arrivals through PR1532. Hanson Sun's
PR1526/1522 use paid signed-connector scaling and a dyadic BIT source tour;
Sricharan Vagvala's PR1532 concerns quadratic readers. These distinct concurrent
results are credited. No priority for paid scaling itself is claimed.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/unipotent-return-seed53
```

Expected: `PASS_UNIPOTENT_RETURN ... total=2494->2234 ... no_new_kappa`, then
`PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`.

CPython 3.12.15 registered replay passes. Read-only standalone relocation in a
path with spaces passes from /tmp under isolated optimized Python 3.11.15 and
3.14.8. Checks cover 161 signed powers, all 6,561 ternary 2-by-4 readers with
81 admitted and replayed, 180 finite unit-tariff cases, full dirty matrices,
literal inverses, recursive invoices, exact prefix maxima, eight mathematical
controls and nine supplementary file-corruption controls. All 25 selected
tests and source bindings pass. RESULT SHA256:
`c7aac8d4478afa4848b30fb3be8cc44701b729c5d4e3bbb14f0ca93da4d87341`.

Finite checks are separate from the written proofs. Linux/hosted CI, full
selected cold replay, physical/tape/rounded supplier admission, Lean and human
review are not claimed. See VALIDATION.md for exact commands and limits.

## Credit

Ross Richardson's PR1287 provides the output-frame/dirty-echo framework and
fixed-child limitation; Sagar Thakrar's PR1227 provides sign frames, with the
PR889 and PR1203 reader/batch lineage retained. The selected construction is
Rohan Arun's PR1094 on Jeremy Kothe's packing and retained PR589/555 bit work.
Prepared by **Sagar Thakrar with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in
derivation, implementation, checking and writing. One agent. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The smallest useful follow-up is to identify one actual indivisible child
with RP=QR; deleting a dispensable trailing drift would make this wrapper
unnecessary. A second scoped question is whether a few intermediate reset
cuts reduce the observed coefficient growth while preserving an operation
saving. Both questions, first steps and blockers are in TASK.json and README.md.
